title: BEC news and announcements
description: The two streams shown on the home page and at /news and /announcements. Array order is the published order; `pinned` items are held at the top of their stream.

date.description: Either an ISO date ("2026-06-12"), rendered as "JUN 12, 2026", or a free-text period label used verbatim ("A.Y. 2026-27", "2025-26 EVEN SEM").

link.description: What opens when the item is clicked, in one of three forms: an attached file on R2 ("documents/news/notice-k3f9wq.pdf"), a site path ("/admissions"), or a full URL. Leave it out and the item renders as plain text.

pinned.description: Hold this item at the top of its stream, above the date order.

images.description: Scans shown beneath the item, side by side on a wide screen. Each opens full size in a new tab.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for a reader using a screen reader and for when it fails to load.
